column1: # Model registry (2026-11-05): the one table every script derives its per-model paths from.
# Tab-separated; "-" = not applicable. Paths: net relative to models/; ref_* relative to models/precomputed/;
# inputs_all, inputs_dir, biases_txt relative to tests/; weights_csv relative to the verified-certified-robustness
# repo root (the CSV weight dirs the attack and provisioning scripts load). layers/isize/eps are the attack
# scripts' arguments (isize is a dummy for the tabular HIGGS models). gram_rq1 = the per-model tightest Gram
# iteration count the RQ1 cex/natgrid runs use, gram_all = the uniform count of the full-set runs; ref_rq1/ref_all
# the Dafny references at those counts (none for HIGGS/EMNIST: L_real baseline). cex_formats = the deployment
# formats with a counterexample suite tests/cex_<dataset>_<format>[_biased_<bias>_<bias_pos>]/ (CIFAR-10 float16
# is excluded by policy: n*u >= 1 on its input layer). The natgrid set of a biased model is
# z3 (synthetic soundness check) is not a model of the paper and stays inline in tests/run_tests.sh.
